description: The rising factorial n^(k) = n*(n+1)*...*(n+k-1). 5^(3) is 210, and 5^(0) is 1. n runs from 0 to 100000 and k runs from 0 to 512. Past 15 digits the value is a decimal string. Price: $0.001 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/rising
